def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    annual_return_rates = [5.2, 7.1, 2.8, 6.5, 3.9, 9.0, 4.6, 8.3, 5.7, 7.4]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    sorted_rates = sorted(annual_return_rates)
    midpoint = len(sorted_rates) // 2
    median_return_rate = (
        sorted_rates[midpoint - 1] + sorted_rates[midpoint]
    ) / 2
    answer = f"{median_return_rate:.2f}%"

    # return answer
    return answer
